lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's HARC meeting, where the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave goes before the commission for three separate Preliminary Large-Scale public hearings — multiple new buildings across Lots 34 and 34B in an Accommodations 2 zone, and the public can weigh in. That same day, HARC also takes up alterations to Town Hall and the Parks & Rec office. On Thursday, the Planning Commission and BOCC sit down together to work through proposed Land Use Code changes touching forestry, oil and gas, deep geothermal, and condominium plats — no final votes, but this is where the shape of those amendments gets decided.

notable.stake: Joint work session shaping Land Use Code amendments across five substantive sections.
HARC reviews alterations to two Town-owned landmark civic buildings.
Public hearings on large-scale Carhenge redevelopment — multiple new buildings in Accommodations 2 zone.
